trigger: raw, URL, revision, SHA-256, license, CRS, or lineage is absent
likely_symptom: artifact cannot be traced to an authoritative source or transform
impact: unverifiable hazard, M7, PLATEAU, or facility connection
allowed_resolution: obtain the official original and record source, transform, tool, and output as separate receipt entities
forbidden_resolution: trust by filename or AI summary
mechanical_check: every source, transform, and output hash resolves

trigger: formal EPSG axis is confused with GeoJSON longitude/latitude serialization
likely_symptom: bounds fall outside the target AOI or latitude/longitude are reversed
first_diagnostic: compare source CRS, formal axis, serialization order, AOI bounds, and a control point
allowed_resolution: record CRS fields separately and validate a versioned transform
mechanical_check: control-point, AOI-bound, round-trip, and axis-mutation checks

trigger: invalid, empty, mixed Polygon/MultiPolygon, or mixed 2D/3D geometry appears
likely_symptom: validation or rendering differs by feature or platform
impact: silent data loss or false overlap
first_diagnostic: inventory validity, empties, dimensions, and geometry types
allowed_resolution: preserve the source and emit a separate repaired artifact with algorithm/version and changed-feature receipt
forbidden_resolution: silently rewrite the source with buffer(0) or equivalent

trigger: planar intersection or nearest-neighbour joins ignore bridge, tunnel, layer, level, or source-node topology
likely_symptom: candidate route crosses a non-existent junction
first_diagnostic: inspect component count and source topology at the suspect junction
allowed_resolution: retain separate components unless explicit connection evidence exists
forbidden_resolution: connect because lines are visually close
mechanical_check: false planar-intersection fixture, layer mutation, component-count regression

trigger: width, slope, surface, kerb, step, wheelchair, or equivalent evidence is missing
likely_symptom: missing attributes appear as zero, false, or PASS
first_diagnostic: produce per-edge completeness and provenance matrix
allowed_resolution: request a traceable source or field measurement and keep each missing attribute explicit
forbidden_resolution: infer numeric values from OSM road class
mechanical_check: missing tag never becomes zero, false, PASS, or computed

trigger: a polygon intersection is translated to CLOSED, FAIL, unsafe, or inaccessible
likely_symptom: edge state changes after overlap-only analysis
first_diagnostic: compare overlap result with edge-state input/output
allowed_resolution: report intersecting/touching/overlap length and source feature IDs only
forbidden_resolution: derive closure or FAIL without an official closure or validated vulnerability model
mechanical_check: overlap mutation cannot change edge state

trigger: coordinate-degree length is labelled metres, walking distance, cost, or time
likely_symptom: UI shows an unsupported metric unit
first_diagnostic: trace calculation, CRS, algorithm, and displayed unit
allowed_resolution: introduce a separately validated geodesic/projected metric contract if required
forbidden_resolution: apply an unexplained constant multiplier to degree length

trigger: clear width, nested buildings, setback, damage, debris, variant, closure, hazard status, or per-field provenance is incomplete
likely_symptom: structurally callable input is mistaken for evidence-ready input
impact: M7 runs on inferred or silent-default evidence
first_diagnostic: run frozen structural and evidence readiness checks per selected edge
allowed_resolution: acquire complete per-field evidence and side-coverage receipts before calling the frozen API
forbidden_resolution: treat empty building lists as evidence without coverage or infer missing values
mechanical_check: structural callable, evidence ready, and computed remain separate

trigger: a legal or design-standard dimension is used as an individual PASS/CONDITIONAL/FAIL boundary
likely_symptom: M6 state table appears production-ready without frozen bindings
first_diagnostic: separate legal conformance, technical guidance, empirical evidence, and profile assessment
allowed_resolution: prepare source-scoped alternatives for human freeze
forbidden_resolution: treat one standard or paper as a universal traversability threshold
mechanical_check: conformance and profile assessment use separate schemas

trigger: LOD, source ID, height/use, road/building relation, or 3D Tiles metadata does not match the official source
likely_symptom: tiles render without verifiable semantics or fail after the root
first_diagnostic: compare source ID, bounds, LOD, revision, root and child content
allowed_resolution: bind only verified source fields and keep absent pedestrian attributes UNKNOWN
forbidden_resolution: label a research extension or arbitrary tileset as PLATEAU production data
mechanical_check: stable IDs, bounds, LOD, root/child, fallback, UNKNOWN attributes

trigger: root loads but child tile, CORS, expiry, signed URL, or content type fails
likely_symptom: 3D stalls, errors, or never returns to 2D
first_diagnostic: check root and child GET, content type, CORS, cache, and expiry separately
allowed_resolution: use a verified stable official remote or bounded local derivative without committed tokens
forbidden_resolution: commit tokenized URLs or keep a failed 3D mode active
mechanical_check: root-success, child-failure, timeout, CORS, expiry E2E

trigger: a facility list entry is interpreted as open, capacitated, accessible, or operational
first_diagnostic: inventory which fields come from identity/location versus operation sources
allowed_resolution: separate identity, location, type, capacity, entrance, hours, fire safety, and accessibility evidence
forbidden_resolution: silent geocoding or infer current operation from existence

trigger: OSM, PLATEAU, municipal GIS, or national data disagree by position, attribute, or version
likely_symptom: one value silently wins or values are averaged
first_diagnostic: compare authority, scope, valid date, resolution, and method per attribute
allowed_resolution: record an attribute-level authority matrix and retain conflicting values
forbidden_resolution: choose newest, average, or silently merge without a frozen rule
mechanical_check: conflicting values remain separate until an explicit decision

trigger: OSM snapshot, PLATEAU year, hazard revision, or facility date differ
first_diagnostic: inventory valid_at, observed_at, published_at, and accessed_at
allowed_resolution: display time metadata and require human freeze for any compatibility window
forbidden_resolution: label layers as same-time when time evidence is absent
mechanical_check: missing time metadata cannot produce same-time wording

trigger: OFFICIAL, VGI, MODEL, and UNKNOWN are mixed, color-only, or limitations are hidden
likely_symptom: users cannot distinguish evidence class or safe default
first_diagnostic: inspect source badges, UNKNOWN rendering, keyboard path, narrow viewport, and map-free table
allowed_resolution: separate source, analysis, and uncertainty badges and keep detail in a drawer/table
forbidden_resolution: claim UI validity without target-user validation
mechanical_check: forbidden wording, keyboard, 320px, table parity, badge and UNKNOWN checks

trigger: a value or method from another jurisdiction, profile, vehicle, or hazard is copied without transfer analysis
likely_symptom: paper-specific rule appears as AblePath production contract
first_diagnostic: check context, population, equipment, environment, units, validation, and transfer_status
allowed_resolution: record caveats and local target-validation plan before any proposal
forbidden_resolution: adopt a paper threshold, weight, state boundary, closure, or safety claim directly
mechanical_check: every adopted paper claim has transfer_status and caveat

trigger: many PDFs are loaded before a decision question is fixed
likely_symptom: important sources, limitations, or provenance are lost in context
first_diagnostic: resolve problem ID and decision question against the literature index first
allowed_resolution: use bibliography index, trigger, exact-page packet, and scope expansion receipt only when necessary
forbidden_resolution: treat bulk reading or an AI summary as evidence
mechanical_check: each decision reverse-resolves to one bounded evidence packet
